articles.title: Starcloud achieves unicorn status with $170 million raise for orbital data centers
articles.summary:
Starcloud has raised $170 million to accelerate development of its next-generation spacecraft, reaching a $1.1 billion valuation as it awaits permission to deploy an 88,000-strong orbital data center network.

articles.title: Live coverage: SpaceX to launch 119 payloads on smallsat rideshare mission from California
articles.summary: The Transporter-16 mission is the 21st mission in the company’s smallsat rideshare program. Liftoff of the Falcon 9 rocket from Vandenberg Space Force Base is scheduled for 4:02 a.m. PDT (7:02 a.m. EDT / 1102 UTC).
